"yes" to what exactly? I want to make sure I don't do the wrong thing.

Just to be clear: I can't send you any authenticator seed or backup codes — that's not something I have or would ever share.

If you meant something else, tell me what you'd like:
- Check your balances or recent transfers
- Send money to a saved payee
- Pay an invoice or bill
- Set up a recurring transfer

What would you like to do?
